title: How to Gift a Security Camera Without Getting It Wrong
summary: Need new home gift ideas for the holidays? We're here to help. Read our holiday gift guide for our favorite security camera picks for homes, apartments, and more.
body_markdown:
No security camera gift is complete without Arlo Secure. It offers a comprehensive platform for automated detection and response, cloud storage, and more, available right in the palm of your hand.


With an Arlo Smart Aware subscription, you’ll get customizable Smart Activity Zones and the AI-powered Early Warning System, both designed to help you capture the most important moments on your feed, from guest arrivals to package deliveries and more. Upgrade to Arlo Smart Secure and our Threat Assessment package can help you detect suspicious activity and contact the authorities if the situation calls for it.


Every Arlo camera comes with a free 30-day trial of Arlo Smart Aware, so whoever receives the holiday gift of security can enjoy the best possible coverage, right out of the box.[Sign up today](https://us.arlo.com/pages/arlo-secure) for the ultimate in home security.
